title: Your entry
summary: The bench entry: the kit's form to the careers address by mailto, beside a sticky 64px claim. The address's status sits once at the label row's right end, “Address to be confirmed” (coherence pass: never inside the sentence).

reference.kelwin: The kit's .ac-field on graphite (no paper: a form is not a document), outlined submit, no red; the claim held beside the form (sticky) so its column is never empty.
